title: Leman Skills
desc: A content-heavy personal brand made clear

blocks.title: Leman Skills
blocks.lede: Making a content-heavy personal brand feel as clear as the person behind it.

items.label: Scope
items.value: IA, navigation, page templates, content hierarchy

blocks.statement: The site had plenty to say. It just didn’t know what to say first.
body: Blog content. Programmes. PCM. Leadership. Podcast. Products. Strong material, grown over time until every section started competing with the next.
Visitors had to work too hard to answer three simple questions: who is this, is it relevant to me, and where do I start?
The website needed to behave like Aleksandra’s work: clear, structured and focused on what actually matters.
The experience was rebuilt around three questions: Who is she? Who does she help? What should I do next?

blocks.text: The website should feel as clear as the work it represents.

body: Navigation was reorganised by intent. Pages received clearer hierarchy and one primary action. Long text blocks became shorter, more breathable sections supported by scannable benefits, social proof and reusable patterns.
The site became easier to understand without losing the depth of the content.
The change was less about adding things and more about giving the existing things a job.
